decisions.reason: These reward-access behaviors depend on the Transak fiat-buyer flow and provisioned wallet, so they necessarily become applicable post-launch when Transak is added.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Having Transak available on day 1 is not especially important because our initial audience will be crypto users.
Therefore, I don't think it should delay the launch, provided we can still add it soon afterward.

(Im currently trying to complete the Transak setup, but I have to wait for the Mauritius incorporation website to be updated, after which it will take some days for Transak to tick it off)

decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already fully records that the Transak fiat-mint integration applies post-launch.
Deferring Transak availability does not change the primary-sale allocation amounts or recipients.
The source preserves launch through crypto payments and does not change the $15 primary mint price.
The unlimited NFT ebook mint remains valid for the initial crypto-user launch; only the Transak path is postponed.
The source does not change the optional tipping behavior or restrict it to the postponed fiat path.

The approved FAQ describes Transak and fiat-buyer rewards as available, but the source does not determine whether that section should be hidden, marked as forthcoming, or retained unchanged until the post-launch integration.
The referral-code identity remains valid for crypto users, while its existing confirmation-email rule already distinguishes fiat buyers without requiring the whole Requirement to become post-launch.
The current About-page state does not require Transak or fiat-buyer wallet provisioning and remains valid for the crypto-first launch.
The crypto-first launch reinforces rather than changes the existing SIWE requirement for crypto mints and transfers.
Automatic prize delivery to a winner wallet remains applicable independently of when Transak and automatic fiat-buyer wallet provisioning become available.
The automatic $5 coded-referral commission remains active for crypto users and is not altered by postponing the fiat on-ramp.
